{{dablink|For other uses of the word "spring," see [[Spring]].}}
The '''Ionin Spring Inn''' is an establishment in [[Ionin Spring]], a village in [[Altara]].

When [[Egwene al'Vere]] enters ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'' physically to travel to [[Salidar]], she identifies the name of the village she is in by the name of the inn.{{ref/book|6|34}}
